data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 17.9m (2017: GBP 26.6m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2017.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a favourable prior-year reserve movement of GBP 17.9m on gross claims reserves held at 31 December 2017, resulting in a release of reserves. The Syndicate is predominantly a UK employers' and public liability (casualty) writer, and the improvement is recorded against the gross claims outstanding. The report attributes this to favourable prior-year claims development rather than changes such as Ogden rate impacts, which were noted as not significant.
raw_causal_phrases: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 17.9m (2017: GBP 26.6m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2017.

The Syndicate reviewed the Ogden discount rate for reserves for large bodily injury claims and used an assumed rate of 0% for the purposes of reserving. The impact on the change in Ogden rate from prior year is not significant on a net basis.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development used the explicit narrative gross figure (GBP 17.9m favourable) stated in the Technical Provisions note (page 29). A gross claims development triangle is present and a triangle-based calculation yields a smaller favourable movement (~GBP 10.77m release); the report's explicit narrative gross figure was used as primary source. No specific named prior-year events were cited as drivers of the movement.
